sources.title: [2412.15115] Qwen2.5 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Open-weight offerings include base and instruction-tuned models, with quantized versions available. In addition, for hosted solutions, the proprietary models currently include two mixture-of-experts (MoE) variants: Qwen2.5-Turbo and Qwen2.5-Plus, both available from Alibaba Cloud Model Studio.

sources.title: Qwen - Read the Docs
sources.snippet: Qwen is the large language model and large multimodal model series of the Qwen Team, Alibaba Group. Both language models and multimodal models are pretrained on large-scale multilingual and multimodal data and post-trained on quality data for aligning to human preferences.

sources.title: GitHub - mx4ai/qwen2.5: Qwen2.5 is the large language model series ...
sources.snippet: Today, we are excited to introduce the latest addition to the Qwen family: Qwen2.5. Dense, easy-to-use, decoder-only language models, available in 0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, 7B, 14B, 32B, and 72B sizes, and base and instruct variants. Pretrained on our latest large-scale dataset, encompassing up to 18T tokens.
